dedupe_keys.name: fame core agent based energy framework

description: FAME-Core is a Java library for building and running distributed agent-based energy-system simulations. It provides shared machinery for agents, communication and execution so model authors can define actors and decision rules for electricity or coupled energy markets. A model’s geographic area, agents and simulated period are supplied by its developer, not fixed in the library. The public GitLab repository and README document Java setup, and its LICENSES directory states Apache-2.0. FAME-Core can support simulations of changing energy prices, investment or actor responses during transition scenarios. A caveat is that it is a framework, not a calibrated energy-market model; results depend on the agents and institutional rules added by users. Java development and parallel execution may also require substantial setup. No catalogue or first-review record matched this named core library. This review read the JOSS summary, own project metadata, README and licence without compiling or running agents. Spatial coverage follows the domain represented by user-defined agents. No directly related catalogue record was established.
